title: All You Have Done
before: You have opened your eyes here before. More times than this book can hold.

back.second: You were only reading it again.

moments.gameStarted: Once again, you opened your eyes in a dark room. The floor was cold. You remembered nothing but your name: {name}. In your hand, two books. A notebook bearing your name. A white book you could no longer read.
moments.firstClick: {when}, you turned your first page. It meant nothing.
moments.firstKnowledge: {when}, in the middle of the gibberish, a sentence. A real one. “The brain skips every other word.” You believed it.
moments.firstBook: {when}, you closed your first book. Four hundred and ten pages. Not one word understood. You kept it. In your pocket, a brass key. You opened the bookcase without thinking. Your hand knew the way.
moments.strangeBook: On the third book, your hand fell on a black book with no title. It spoke to you. It knew everything about you.
moments.firstAnomaly: {when}, a sentence spoke to you. It should not have.
moments.rareBook: {when}, between two nameless books: {title}. You put it with the others.
moments.firstSeal: {when}, the black book set its first seal upon you.
moments.firstAbsence: You slept. When you woke, the pages had turned without you.
moments.end: That is all. That is all you have done.

methods.diagonal: {when}, you learned to skip every other word.
methods.finger: {when}, your finger began to guide your eyes. They no longer went back.
methods.voice: {when}, the voice in your head fell silent. Without it, you went faster.
methods.lectern: {when}, you tore a stone from the railing. It became your lectern.
methods.ladder: {when}, you found a ladder. The top shelves became yours.
methods.cornee: {when}, you found a dog-eared page again. You did not remember folding it.
methods.metronome: {when}, you wound a metronome. Your eyes took up its pace.
methods.wheel: {when}, you built a wheel. The books turned before you.
methods.lift: {when}, you lowered a basket into the well. It came back up full.
methods.automaton: {when}, an automaton began to read for you. It understood nothing. Neither did you.
methods.clock: {when}, you heard the gallery clock. Since then, the whole gallery reads with you.

memories.cup: {when}, a memory came back. A chipped cup. You always drank from the chipped side.

books.100: A hundred books closed behind you.
books.1000: A thousand books. You had stopped counting.

pages.1000000: A million pages. Not one of them looked like you.

secrets.insomnia: One night, at three o'clock, you were still reading.
secrets.still: One day, you held your book perfectly still.
secrets.babelDigits: You learned to count the way the Library does.
secrets.colleagues: Two books spoke of someone. You never met anyone.
